Preconditions: API Server is listening on test port
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /api/health
2. Verify HTTP status is 200
3. Verify JSON success is true
Expected Result: Status: 200 OK, success: true, message: "SecureVault API is running"
Actual Result: Status: 200, Success: true, Message: "SecureVault API is running"

Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /api/health
2. Verify lanIp field is resolved

Test Steps:
1. Send POST /api/auth/register with empty fields
2. Verify 400 Bad Request error returned
Expected Result: Status 400 Bad Request with validation errors

Test Steps:
1. Send POST /api/auth/login with wrong credentials
2. Verify 401 Unauthorized or 400
Actual Result: Status: 401, Unauthorized login rejected securely

Test Steps:

2. Verify rejection
Actual Result: Status: 401, Malformed refresh token safely rejected
